title: Earthquake: Drop, Cover, Hold On
summary: Drop to hands and knees; cover head and neck under sturdy furniture; hold on until shaking stops.

key_points: cover head and neck under sturdy furniture

sections.heading: Key points
sections.body: Earthquake: Drop, Cover, Hold On. Drop to hands and knees; cover head and neck under sturdy furniture; hold on until shaking stops.

sections.heading: Procedure
sections.body: Drop: get low before the shaking knocks you down. Cover: shelter under a sturdy table, covering head and neck. Hold on: stay put until shaking fully stops. After: check for injuries, expect aftershocks, and avoid elevators.

record_text:
Key points.
Earthquake: Drop, Cover, Hold On. Drop to hands and knees; cover head and neck under sturdy furniture; hold on until shaking stops.

Procedure.
Drop: get low before the shaking knocks you down. Cover: shelter under a sturdy table, covering head and neck. Hold on: stay put until shaking fully stops. After: check for injuries, expect aftershocks, and avoid elevators.
source_note: Sourced: standard public-safety guidance; get certified hands-on training for medical procedures.
